page.overview:
Who is Jynne Celwik?

Jynne Celwik was a Human female waitress at the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant prior to the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, she was working in the club, searching for big tippers and thirsty customers, on the night bounty hunter Zam Wesell ran into the club to hide from Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.

Jynne Celwik was a Human female employed as a waitress at the Outlander Club, the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. Celwik was working at the club the night of the attempted assassination on Senator Padmé Amidala,

The assassin, bounty hunter Zam Wesell, ran into the club to hide while being chased by the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker. Just as the Jedi entered the club, she serviced a table, later making rounds through the club as Skywalker surveyed the crowd. She poured a drink for a patron moments before Kenobi sliced off Wesell's arm with his lightsaber at the bar of the club. While patrons of the club had their attention drawn to the altercation, Celwik did not turn to look and walked away from the table. Wesell was removed from the waitress's workplace shortly after.

Celwik had curled blonde hair and light skin.
